## Phase 1 Stage 1 evidence dossier (descriptive)

### Reproduction and size layers
- Fresh clone: `/tmp/rebar-tickets-size.dPH4Em/fresh`, only the `tickets` branch, tip `2fd4a1a62c92f534825097153dd1767e97ec4b47`.
- Checked-out ticket tree: 112,788 files; 827,550,463 logical bytes; 1,116,577,792 4-KiB-allocated bytes. The difference is 289,027,329 bytes of filesystem block slack.
- Fresh clone `.git`: 358,767,066 logical bytes. `git count-objects -vH`: one pack, 535,779 objects, 322.57 MiB; zero loose, prune-packable, or garbage objects.
- Entire checkout: 1,186,317,529 logical bytes and 1,475,424,256 allocated bytes. The reported greater-than-1-GiB state reproduces without any pre-existing local clone.

### Reachability and prior rewrite
- `git fsck --full --unreachable --no-reflogs` emitted nothing.
- The only refs are `refs/heads/tickets` and `refs/remotes/origin/tickets`, both at the same tip. The pre-rewrite tip `68a705df011fb7b5e5f97481312611ecb8d758cb` is absent.
- Post-rewrite baseline `1300f383c75b10231fbd814cb9f6a1dfa269a26e` to current tip: files 39,142 -> 112,788; logical tree 290,690,203 -> 827,550,463 bytes; 4-KiB-rounded tree 396,152,832 -> 1,116,577,792 bytes; commits 68,920 -> 151,184; merges 4,663 -> 18,977.
- Closed epic `censual-organic-mouflon` records a post-rewrite fresh clone of 113,467 KiB and preserved 68,920 commits / 4,663 merges.

### Current tree and reachable-pack composition
- Logical tree categories: retired snapshots 254,853,040; review results 238,486,830; other retired events 127,483,175; active snapshots 95,128,343; enrichment lifecycle 71,921,418; other 25,559,514; `.bridge_state` 14,118,143 bytes.
- Reachable packed-entry bytes by object type: blobs 235,538,455; trees 60,149,990; commits 27,548,070.
- Objects added since the rewrite baseline contribute 223,284,957 packed-entry bytes: trees 52,256,074; `.bridge_state` 51,853,550; enrichment 24,922,870; active snapshots 24,341,841; retired snapshots 23,277,254; commits 15,617,991; other retired events 13,799,246; review results 12,324,456.
- The 82,264 post-baseline commits include 14,313 merges and 41,541 enrichment-lifecycle commits.

### Concentrated repeated content
Only three tickets contain exact repeated reconciler-authored COMMENT bodies under distinct Jira comment IDs:
- `undyed-high-kiwi` (`8625-7bea-67db-4cdc`, Jira `REB-1567`): 394 comments, 13 unique bodies, directory 174,969,874 bytes; three large bodies recur roughly 128 times each.
- `icicled-unstable-urial` (`9305-b42c-3262-4c58`, Jira `REB-1931`): 262 comments, 17 unique bodies, directory 69,311,996 bytes; two large bodies recur roughly 123 times each.
- `weary-wavy-hen` (`e27c-5a20-cd13-43b2`, Jira `REB-2605`): 135 comments, 8 unique bodies, directory 28,633,659 bytes; one large body recurs roughly 128 times.
- Conservative exact-duplicate attribution: 760 excess COMMENT event files / 18,496,834 bytes plus 229,222,450 repeated body bytes embedded in snapshots (17,164,261 active; 212,058,189 retired) = 247,719,284 bytes. This is 29.9% of the logical tree and 90.7% of those three directories.

### Operational and historical observations
- Closed bug `irongrey-chubby-oxpecker` reports 205 outbound comments posted per hourly pass across 28 Jira issues; commit `27b868ba55eb5f699d3c4b0b72891aaeb969eef3` introduced the comment-ID map under story `emersed-specific-mutt` (`789c-1251-fc21-4cf6`).
- Jira cleanup `darkish-enormous-raptors` deleted 29,931 marked duplicate Jira comments. It separately recorded 836 unmarked, exactly-32,767-character bot echoes on REB-1567 / REB-1931 / REB-2605; phase 2 was not executed.
- Fix `8d98c298fa816acf51b1bae069f36695066b2695` is an ancestor of workflow head `8fa8f36b6482b2371128607a63c5483a9783e887`. First resumed run 32447039101 posted the then-unmapped backlog, including 3 / 7 / 1 comments on those Jira issues. Second run 32447697242 reported inbound comments on three issues and committed six COMMENT events at 04:41:50-52Z under distinct Jira IDs. Third run 32447928090 reported `inbound_differ ... with_comments=0` and `Reconcile converged.` No later exact-body duplicate COMMENT event exists through this clone.
- Compaction threshold is 10 (`docs/config-reference.md:85`); scheduled sweep is six-hourly and closes can trigger the detached operation-linked sweep (`docs/concurrency.md:394-428`). Current code renames every folded source to `.retired` (`compact_txn.py:266-322`); docs state retention is permanent pending causal-stability GC (`docs/concurrency.md:61-67`). Open `polite-antivirus-bedbug` records that no proof of causal stability currently exists.
- Separate observation: `.bridge_state/peer_confirmations.json` has 418 touching commits / 417 unique blobs totaling 320,864,708 raw bytes. The current 1,400,452-byte file has 3,499 records; the latest pass changed 1,225 records only in `confirmed_pass` / `confirmed_at`. This is filed separately as `proposed-kitschy-firefly`, linked `discovered_from`.

### Leads to test in Stage 2
1. Working-tree allocation may be primarily logical retained data plus small-file block slack, rather than a one-gigabyte Git pack.
2. High commit/tree volume may materially explain pack size but not checked-out tree bytes.
3. The six repeated comment bodies may be the anomalous data source, with compaction snapshots and permanent `.retired` retention multiplying their residence.
4. The prior history rewrite may remain effective, with new reachable data accumulated after its baseline rather than old history resurfacing.
5. `.bridge_state` may contain an ongoing independent churn mechanism, but its current tree residence may be too small to explain the reported checkout size.

Open questions for Stage 2/3: confirm the exact runtime control flow that admitted the Jira copies locally; distinguish final post-fix convergence from recurrence; establish defect legitimacy and origin; test all rival explanations against byte totals.

## Phase 1 Stage 2 — empirical challenge and correction

An independent full-tree/object-history pass confirmed the main measurements and added two material qualifications.

1. The greater-than-1-GiB observation is an allocation result, not a one-GiB Git pack. At measured tip `2fd4a1a62c92f534825097153dd1767e97ec4b47`, the checked-out tree is 112,788 files / 827,550,463 logical B / 1,116,577,792 allocated B. The 289,027,329 B difference is block slack. `.git` is 358,767,066 logical B; its one pack file is 323,236,547 B. Whole clone is 1,186,317,529 logical B / 1,475,424,256 allocated B.

2. Correction to the preliminary `9305` count: `icicled-unstable-urial` has 270 raw COMMENT files. Its active snapshot contains 262 comments and eight later COMMENT events remain live. The six exact recurring groups are: `8625` three bodies x128, `9305` two bodies x127, and `e27c` one body x128. That yields 760 conservative excess COMMENT files / 18,496,834 B, plus 17,164,261 duplicate body B in active snapshots and 212,058,189 B in retired snapshots: 247,719,284 B total, 29.934% of the current logical tree and 46.142% of logical growth since the rewrite. All events are reconciler-authored, have distinct Jira identities where required by the test, and occur on an approximately hourly cadence from Aug 14 through the final Aug 21 imports.

3. The duplicate payload is embedded in structurally distinct signed JSON, not explained by whole-file copies: a whole-tree SHA-256 scan found only 127 excess identical tiny tombstones. Snapshot size tracks accumulated comment count almost perfectly for the three affected directories. This supports full-state folding plus permanent retired-source retention as the multiplier.

4. The comment loop is the principal anomalous payload, but it did not itself cross the allocation threshold. Allocation was 904.7 MB on Aug 20, 983.6 MB on Aug 21, 1.051 GB on Aug 22, and 1.116 GB at the measured tip. From Aug 20 to tip, enrichment lifecycle activity added 34,289 files / 55,297,265 logical B / 140,500,992 allocated B, 66.32% of that interval allocation increase. Thus already-accumulated comment-loop bloat set the high base; an append-only enrichment small-file burst was the immediate threshold trigger.

5. Small files are therefore a material amplifier, not a complete explanation: 89,577 files at or below 4 KiB contain 132,902,547 B but allocate 366,903,296 B, for 234,000,749 B slack. Commit/tree volume is material to the 323 MB pack only: packed entries are blobs 235,538,455 B, trees 60,149,981 B, commits 27,548,070 B.

6. Stale-history alternatives remain rejected: only matching local/remote tickets refs, no tags, empty unreachable fsck, and absent pre-rewrite tip. The prior rewrite remains effective; all measured growth is newly reachable. The existing idea epic `apparent-sighted-cockatoo` already owns merge-safe bounding of ENQUEUE/CLAIM/DONE enrichment and digest history, so no duplicate follow-up is warranted.

7. Convergence remains proven: fix `8d98c298` is deployed; the resumed runs progressed through map population, final markerless echo import, then `typed_inbound_dispatched count=0` / `BRIDGE_STATE: converged`. No later target-body COMMENT exists through the measured tip. The stored damage remains reachable, but the exact loop is not still running.

## Phase 1 exit — confirmed root cause (analysis only)

### Problem and measurement result

A fresh, unfiltered, single-branch clone reproduces the report at tickets tip `2fd4a1a62c92f534825097153dd1767e97ec4b47`; this is not a stale-local-clone artifact.

| Layer | Exact result |
|---|---:|
| Reachable Git pack | 322.57 MiB (535,779 objects, one pack) |
| `.git` logical size | 358,767,066 B |
| Checked-out tree logical | 827,550,463 B (789.21 MiB) |
| Checked-out tree 4-KiB allocated | 1,116,577,792 B (1.040 GiB) |
| Tree block slack | 289,027,329 B |
| Whole fresh clone logical / allocated | 1,186,317,529 B / 1,475,424,256 B |

The tree has 112,788 files. Of them, 89,577 (79.42%) are at most 4 KiB: they hold 132,902,547 logical bytes but allocate 366,903,296 bytes. Those files contribute 234,000,749 bytes, or 81% of all block slack. Thus the checked-out tree exceeds 1 GiB physically even though its logical payload is only 789.21 MiB. The Git branch pack itself is not over 1 GiB.

Current tree attribution, logical / 4-KiB allocated bytes:

- retired snapshots: 254,853,040 / 258,666,496
- review results: 238,486,830 / 255,561,728
- other retired events: 127,483,175 / 239,804,416
- active snapshots: 95,128,343 / 108,331,008
- enrichment lifecycle: 71,921,418 / 198,225,920
- other: 25,559,514 / 41,857,024
- `.bridge_state`: 14,118,143 / 14,131,200

### Proven anomalous-data mechanism

Exactly three tickets dominate the abnormal payload:

- `undyed-high-kiwi` (`8625-7bea-67db-4cdc`): 174,969,874 B
- `icicled-unstable-urial` (`9305-b42c-3262-4c58`): 69,311,996 B
- `weary-wavy-hen` (`e27c-5a20-cd13-43b2`): 28,633,659 B

Six large bodies were imported repeatedly under distinct Jira comment IDs. Conservative exact attribution is 760 excess COMMENT files / 18,496,834 B plus 229,222,450 repeated body bytes embedded in snapshots (17,164,261 active; 212,058,189 retired): 247,719,284 B total. That is 29.93% of the whole logical tree, 46.14% of logical growth since the rewrite, and 90.77% of those three directories. Recurring snapshots amplify the raw duplicate-event bytes by about 13.4x.

The execution chain is confirmed:

1. Commit `27b868ba55eb5f699d3c4b0b72891aaeb969eef3`, ticket `emersed-specific-mutt` (`789c-1251-fc21-4cf6`), introduced the persistent comment-ID map but assumed every successful `add_comment` returned a top-level `{"id": ...}`. The story description states that exact contract. Cloud ACLI actually returns a batch envelope with no created-comment ID; historical `_record_comment_id` silently returned, leaving production `comment_ids` empty. Runtime proof and elimination of the other guards are recorded on `irongrey-chubby-oxpecker` (`aa7b-5e47-6d3d-4615`). Current repair code documents the transport asymmetry at `dispatch_apply_phases.py:311-352`.
2. With the primary mapped-key guard inert, only lossy body equality remained. Rich ADF/wiki round-tripping changed bodies, so the secondary test at `outbound_comments.py:671-725` re-posted them each pass.
3. Oversized outbound comments were decorated and then right-truncated, cutting off the trailing reconciler marker. That necessary historical condition is documented/fixed by `unreal-empathetic-illadopsis` (`5931-78a3-95d2-44cd`) and `outbound_comments.py:227-305`.
4. Inbound sync filters marker-bearing echoes, then deduplicates by Jira ID, not body (`inbound_collection_diffs.py:97-166`). Each re-post had a distinct Jira ID, so every markerless copy became a distinct local COMMENT event (`apply_inbound_events.py:516-537`).
5. Compaction writes the complete reduced ticket state into each new SNAPSHOT, renames every folded event and prior snapshot to `.retired`, and retains them permanently (`compact_txn.py:266-322,470-545`; `docs/concurrency.md:61-67`). On the largest ticket, retained snapshots progress from 28 comments / 600,873 B shortly after the introducing change to 388 comments / 8,730,955 B; the active 394-comment snapshot is 10,082,163 B. This directly confirms snapshot size follows compiled comment count.

### Why the physical threshold was crossed now

The duplicate-comment/snapshot chain is the largest abnormal retained payload, but it is not by itself the instant of threshold crossing. Allocated tree size was:

- Aug 20: 904,732,672 B
- Aug 21: 983,625,728 B
- Aug 22: 1,051,222,016 B (over decimal 1 GB)
- Aug 23: 1,116,577,792 B (over 1 GiB)

From Aug 21 through Aug 23, merge-safe enrichment retention added 34,289 files, 55,297,265 logical bytes, and 140,500,992 allocated bytes. This small-file burst pushed the already-bloated tree across the physical boundary. Current enrichment lifecycle residence is 48,372 files / 71,921,418 logical B / 198,225,920 allocated B. Physical pruning was deliberately removed by commit `be8a0c059571b340cd7705191769a4a64998643d`, because deleting committed UUID events breaks stale-clone union reconvergence. The separate retry bug fixed by `spongy-illjudged-terrier` (`569c-931f-69a2-4c1d`) contributed hundreds of unnecessary claims, but does not explain most of the 34,289-file burst.

Therefore the parsimonious threshold account is composite: historical comment echoes created the largest abnormal logical payload; full-state snapshots plus permanent retirement multiplied and preserved it; intentional enrichment lifecycle retention plus 4-KiB block rounding supplied the immediate physical threshold crossing.

### Prior rewrite and current fixes

The prior history reclaim remains effective on the layer it actually rewrote. Baseline `1300f383c75b10231fbd814cb9f6a1dfa269a26e` had 39,142 files, 290,690,203 logical tree bytes, 396,152,832 allocated tree bytes, 68,920 commits, and 4,663 merges. Current content is newly reachable post-rewrite material. `git fsck --full --unreachable --no-reflogs` is empty; the fresh clone has only local/remote tickets refs at one tip; the pre-rewrite tip is absent. The rewrite deliberately restored an identical HEAD tree and removed historical `.bridge_state` versions, so its <=150 MiB acceptance measured pack size, not checkout or whole-clone footprint.

The comment defects are also fixed, but fixes do not retroactively delete committed artifacts. Fix `8d98c298fa816acf51b1bae069f36695066b2695` is deployed; current `bindings.json` has 790 comment-map entries. The first resumed pass posted the previously unmapped backlog once, the next imported remaining echoes, and the third reported `with_comments=0` / `Reconcile converged.` No later exact-body duplicate COMMENT event exists through the frozen tip. Marker-preservation fix `6724e79e8ff857b54dd36a62006a89445fc10ad6` is also deployed.

### Rival hypotheses rejected or bounded

- **Old unreachable history / ref pins / failed rewrite:** rejected by the fresh-clone reproduction, single-tip ref set, empty unreachable fsck, and absent old tip.
- **High commit count alone:** contributing only to `.git`, not the checkout. Packed commit objects occupy 27,548,070 B and trees 60,149,990 B. Commit objects cannot enlarge the checked-out tree.
- **Whole-file duplication defeating Git blob identity:** rejected. Only 128 identical 21-byte tombstones exist (2,667 excess logical bytes). The repeated payload is inside structurally distinct signed events/snapshots; delta compression is why the pack is much smaller than the checkout.
- **Review results as the new anomaly:** large retained baseline, not the sudden mechanism. They occupy 238,486,830 B now, but about 170.3 MB already existed at the rewrite baseline.
- **Renewed old `.bridge_state` cache churn:** rejected as checkout cause. Current `.bridge_state` is 14.1 MB; `bindings.json` has zero `baseline_advanced_at` and zero inline `last_get_pass` fields. Separate peer-confirmation no-op rewrites are real but the path-specific cost is 6,077,416 packed bytes, not the 1-GiB tree; corrected on `proposed-kitschy-firefly`.
- **Current recurrence of the comment loop:** rejected by deployed ancestry, the three-pass convergence sequence, 790 mapped comments, and absence of later duplicate events.

### Legitimacy, origin, and disposition

The comment-map behavior is a confirmed `defect`: it violates `emersed-specific-mutt`'s explicit append-once acceptance criteria and existing map-persistence tests. The attributed origin is commit `27b868ba55...` / `emersed-specific-mutt` (`789c-1251-fc21-4cf6`), classified `plan_defect`: its central transport-contract assumption was false. The marker-loss condition came through the untrailered standalone-rebar import `b534f47a7f9...`; no earlier project ticket/proven introducing change is available, so that necessary secondary origin is explicitly unattributable/preexisting rather than guessed.

No Phase 2 repair was authorized or performed in this ticket. Existing repairs are deployed; remaining work is safe reclamation and growth control:

- `irongray-unlucky-discus` (`93c4-2b9f-749a-4243`): safe targeted reclaim of the proven duplicate comments/snapshots.
- `epidemic-chocolaty-imago` (`0754-cfc5-e451-4e9b`): whole-store budgets for pack, logical tree, allocated tree, file count/slack, and total clone.
- `apparent-sighted-cockatoo` (`4520-11a6-7458-454f`): merge-safe enrichment retention/archival design.
- `polite-antivirus-bedbug` (`536b-8930-b922-4063`): `.retired` GC after a real causal-stability model exists.
- `proposed-kitschy-firefly` (`266c-394a-9e6f-4c2e`): bound peer-confirmation sidecar churn (measurement corrected to 6,077,416 packed bytes for that path).

Conclusion: the prior cache-history rewrite and reconciler fixes worked, but they addressed different layers and did not erase retained ticket artifacts. The current >1-GiB physical tree is explained by a proven historical comment-echo payload amplified by snapshot retention, then pushed over the boundary by enrichment small files and block slack.

comments.body:
## Phase 1 exit — confirmed root-cause analysis (read-only; no repair)

### Problem and exact size layer

A fresh single-branch clone at tickets tip `2fd4a1a62c92f534825097153dd1767e97ec4b47` reproduces the report, but the phrase “branch is over 1 GB” conflates distinct layers:

- checked-out ticket tree: 112,788 files, 827,550,463 logical bytes, 1,116,577,792 bytes allocated in 4-KiB blocks;
- `.git`: 358,767,066 logical bytes;
- whole clone: 1,186,317,529 logical / 1,475,424,256 allocated bytes;
- reachable Git pack: 322.57 MiB including index (`git count-objects -vH`), not 1 GiB.

The immediate >1-GiB threshold is therefore the checked-out tree’s allocated footprint: 827.6 MB of real file content plus 289.0 MB of filesystem block slack.

### Proven causal account

1. **The earlier reclaim succeeded, but measured a different thing.** Rewrite baseline `1300f383c75b10231fbd814cb9f6a1dfa269a26e` preserved the HEAD tree byte-for-byte and bounded the pack/history. The old pre-rewrite tip `68a705df011fb7b5e5f97481312611ecb8d758cb` is absent; a fresh clone has only local/remote `tickets`, no tags, no unreachable objects, and no reflog pin. Since that baseline, the live tree grew 290,690,203 -> 827,550,463 logical bytes and 396,152,832 -> 1,116,577,792 allocated bytes. This is new reachable data, not resurrected history.

2. **A resolved outbound reconciler defect generated the anomalous payload.** Commit `27b868ba55eb5f699d3c4b0b72891aaeb969eef3` (story `emersed-specific-mutt`, `789c-1251-fc21-4cf6`) introduced the persistent comment-ID map but assumed successful `add_comment` returned a top-level Jira comment `id`. Cloud/ACLI actually returns a batch envelope with no top-level comment ID. The original `_record_comment_id` silently returned, production’s map stayed empty, the primary identity skip never fired, and rich comments whose bodies changed through ADF/wiki round-tripping were posted again every hourly pass. This mechanism was previously proven at runtime on bug `irongrey-chubby-oxpecker`; the explicit `caused_by` link to `emersed-specific-mutt` is recorded here.

3. **A second, pre-existing marker-order defect let only the over-length echoes re-enter the local store.** Decoration appended `RECONCILER_MARKER` after the body, then right-truncation removed it. Jira therefore held 836 markerless, exactly-limit bot echoes on REB-1567, REB-1931, and REB-2605. The inbound loop-breaker could not recognize them as reconciler echoes, so their distinct Jira IDs were validly imported as distinct local COMMENT events. That defect was separately proven/fixed under `unreal-empathetic-illadopsis` (`5931-78a3-95d2-44cd`); its origin is rigorously unattributable inside rebar because marker and truncation arrived together in pre-history import `b534f47a7f`.

4. **Append-only compaction amplified the imported bodies.** Six large bodies appear in 127–128 approximately hourly copies from 2026-08-14 06:53Z through 2026-08-21 04:41Z, all authored `reconciler`, concentrated in:
   - `undyed-high-kiwi`: 174,969,874 bytes;
   - `icicled-unstable-urial`: 69,311,996 bytes;
   - `weary-wavy-hen`: 28,633,659 bytes.

   There are 760 redundant COMMENT files totaling 18,496,834 bytes. Compaction writes a new full snapshot and renames every folded source `.retired`; current policy retains retired events and snapshots permanently pending causal-stability GC. Consequently the same bodies occupy another 17,164,261 bytes in active snapshots and 212,058,189 bytes in retired snapshots. Conservative redundant footprint: **247,719,284 bytes**, a 13.39x amplification over the redundant source events, 29.93% of the live tree, 90.77% of those three directories, and 46.14% of logical growth since the rewrite baseline. Snapshot size versus comment count correlations are 0.997, 0.99999, and 0.981.

5. **Other retained data and block slack explain the rest and the final threshold crossing.** Current logical tree categories are: retired snapshots 254,853,040; REVIEW_RESULT 238,486,830; other retired events 127,483,175; active snapshots 95,128,343; enrichment lifecycle 71,921,418; other 25,559,514; `.bridge_state` 14,118,143 bytes. Of 112,788 files, 89,577 are <=4 KiB: they contain 132,902,547 logical bytes but allocate 366,903,296, contributing 234,000,749 bytes of slack. After the duplicate loop stopped, 34,289 enrichment lifecycle files added 55,297,265 logical but 140,500,992 allocated bytes; that was 66.3% of post-Aug-20 allocation growth and pushed the checkout across 1 GiB.

### Rival explanations tested

- **Stale refs / unreachable pre-rewrite history:** rejected by the fresh clone’s ref set, absent old tip, and empty `git fsck --full --unreachable --no-reflogs`.
- **Commit count as the direct gigabyte:** rejected. There are 151,184 commits and 18,977 merges, but packed commit entries are only 27,548,070 bytes; trees are 60,149,981 and blobs 235,538,455. Raw object-size sums (36.8 GB) compress/delta to a 323.2-MB pack and must not be treated as disk usage.
- **Many small files alone:** rejected as a complete explanation. Their block slack is material (234.0 MB), but the tree also contains 827.6 MB of logical payload.
- **Whole-file duplication:** rejected. Exact hashing found only 127 duplicate 21-byte tombstones; timestamps, Jira IDs, UUIDs, signatures, and nested snapshot metadata make the large files distinct even when bodies repeat.
- **Renewed bridge-state churn as the checkout root:** rejected. `peer_confirmations.json` has a real volatile-field rewrite defect, but its current file is 1,400,452 bytes and its 417 unique historical blobs occupy about 6,077,416 packed bytes. It is separately filed, not misattributed to the >1-GiB tree.

### Resolution state

Fix `8d98c298fa816acf51b1bae069f36695066b2695` records a successful post even when ACLI cannot return a comment ID. It is an ancestor of workflow head `8fa8f36b6482b2371128607a63c5483a9783e887`. Run 32447039101 posted the then-unmapped backlog; run 32447697242 imported the final six repeated events; run 32447928090 reported zero inbound comment differences and converged. No later copy of the six anomalous bodies exists through the frozen tickets tip. Marker-preserving fix `6724e79e8ff857b54dd36a62006a89445fc10ad6` is also on current main.

**Conclusion:** the reconciler loop really did create a major anomalous payload, but it is no longer recurring. The current >1-GiB checkout is retained historical damage amplified by full snapshots/permanent `.retired` retention, combined with normal-but-unbounded review/enrichment payloads and small-file allocation. The prior pack-history reclaim did not regress; its pack-only acceptance metric could not detect this tree/allocation growth.

### Residual dispositions

- `irongray-unlucky-discus`: safe targeted reclaim for the 247,719,284-byte duplicate footprint.
- `epidemic-chocolaty-imago`: enforce separate pack, logical-tree, allocated-tree, file/slack, and whole-clone budgets.
- `degradable-appalling-cavy`: bound/reclaim 238,486,830 bytes of active+retired REVIEW_RESULT sidecars.
- `proposed-kitschy-firefly`: stop volatile `confirmed_pass` / `confirmed_at` refreshes from rewriting the full peer-confirmation sidecar.

No production files were changed and no repair/rewrite was attempted in this investigation.

## Remediation plan — dependency ordered and guarded by prior-repair evidence

### Goal

Reduce the retained damage safely, then bound each independent growth slope. Success is measured separately for reachable pack bytes, logical checkout bytes, 4-KiB allocated checkout bytes, file count/slack, and whole fresh-clone footprint. Commit count is diagnostic, not the storage objective.

### Phase 0 — containment and a trustworthy measurement seam

Owner: epidemic-chocolaty-imago for measurement; existing fixes and prissy-comic-koi for containment evidence.

1. Keep fixes 8d98c298 (ID-less Cloud post recording) and 6724e79e (marker-preserving fit) deployed. Before any reclaim, require two consecutive production-equivalent reconcile observations with no new target-body COMMENT events, no comment-id divergence alert, and zero comment mutations on the second unchanged pass.
2. Do not build a duplicate alert path. The operation-linked invariant from prissy-comic-koi already counts successful posts versus comment-map growth. Audit whether its none-vs-some predicate is sufficient for partial recording and overwrite cases; strengthen that seam only if a falsifiable test demonstrates a blind spot.
3. Land read-only footprint instrumentation first from epidemic-chocolaty-imago. It must report pack, logical tree, allocated tree, file count/slack, and total clone from a fresh unfiltered tickets clone, plus per-producer/category deltas. CI may call it, but an in-process or operation-linked trigger is required for portability.
4. Record the current bloated tip as incident evidence, not as an acceptable baseline. Establish shrink-only enforcement baselines after the targeted reclaim, then ratchet them after each producer fix.

Gate to Phase 1: containment observations pass, measurement is reproducible, and the exact remote tip to be reclaimed is frozen by lease.

### Phase 1 — manifest-driven targeted reclaim

Owner: irongray-unlucky-discus. This is the only immediate destructive operation.

1. On claim, correct its conflicting acceptance criterion. Removing duplicate local comments necessarily changes reduced state. The permitted semantic delta is: only explicitly enumerated reconciler echo copies disappear; one legitimate survivor per distinct source comment remains; every other comment, field, link, status, authorship fact, and audit record remains identical.
2. Build an immutable manifest joining all six body groups across the three tickets to:
   - local COMMENT event UUID, HLC key, body hash, and jira_comment_id;
   - every active and retired snapshot containing the copy;
   - current bridge comment_ids entries;
   - live Jira comment IDs and bodies.
   Selection may not rely on body equality or oldest/newest order alone.
3. Reuse the lessons from darkish-enormous-raptors and just-preglacial-yeti. The Jira cleanup proved that the post-reenable sweep must preserve the copy referenced by comment_ids. A fresh live audit must therefore choose a survivor whose Jira identity is still live and preserve every authoritative mapped ID. If Jira still contains extra copies, clean the remote side first under a complete backup, dry run, canary, retry-safe deletion log, and post-read verification; then require two-pass convergence before touching local history.
4. Implement the rewrite through a first-class audited reclaim surface. tracker-maintenance --clean currently repairs only stranded index entries and foreign paths; it is not authority to delete arbitrary ticket history. Extend the supported maintenance/reclaim surface or add a dedicated manifest-driven command with: refusal on unpushed work, backup before first write, durable audit, exact target allowlist, dry-run default, and no break-glass use.
5. Reuse the Aug 6 quiet-window protocol rather than improvising:
   - pause every writer and prove exact deployed writer identities;
   - verify no in-flight reconcile, review-bot, MCP, host, or scheduled writer;
   - create and independently restore an off-repo Git bundle before any mutation;
   - run only in a fresh unfiltered clone;
   - bump the store epoch and prove stale-clone refusal at both sync union and push non-FF union sites;
   - publish only with an exact old-tip lease;
   - re-clone/converge every persistent writer, carrying the four git-ignored local identity files where applicable.
6. Do not reuse the old history-strip assertions verbatim. The Aug 6 rewrite deliberately re-added the complete current tree and required HEAD tree identity, which would preserve this incident. Here the HEAD tree must differ by the manifest-defined semantic delta. Preserve the DAG shape and commit/merge counts where feasible, remap authorship ledger commit positions using the already-fixed identity verifier, and require normalized pre/post authorship results to match.
7. Verify before and after publication:
   - manifest target coverage is exact and no non-target path changes;
   - reduced states differ only by enumerated echo removals;
   - legitimate comment and live Jira-ID parity holds;
   - fsck and full replay are clean;
   - all five footprint layers are reported;
   - a default clone contains no pre-rewrite tip or pin;
   - a synthetic stale writer refuses without merge;
   - two unchanged reconciler passes create no replacement comments.
8. Rollback is a second quiesced window restoring the verified bundle by exact lease, followed by writer re-clone. Never bypass the epoch mismatch in application merge paths.

Expected incident-specific reclaim is at least the proven 247,719,284 logical bytes at the frozen tip, reported as an estimate before mutation and an observation afterward. No pack or allocated-byte result may be inferred from that logical figure.

### Phase 2 — stop avoidable growth in parallel after measurement exists

These work items can proceed independently once Phase 0 measurement is available; none replaces Phase 1 reclaim.

- proposed-kitschy-firefly: make unchanged peer-confirmation evidence byte-stable. Use the corrected path-specific packed cost of 6,077,416 bytes, not the earlier 51.85 MB attribution.
- degradable-appalling-cavy: bound both active and retired REVIEW_RESULT sidecars while preserving review recall, audit, calibration, and stale-clone safety. Current footprint is 238,486,830 logical bytes.
- melancholy-couped-turkey: RESEARCH adaptive snapshot cadence. Compare fixed-count, geometric, and byte/replay-cost-aware schedules. Preserve ADR 0035 conservative horizon/rebuild-on-stray, first-snapshot backfill, crash recovery, authorship ledger, and two-clone union semantics. Keep execution in the six-hour out-of-band sweep; never reintroduce compact-on-close lock starvation.
- apparent-sighted-cockatoo: design merge-safe retention for enrichment lifecycle files. The immediate threshold trigger was 34,289 new small files and 140,500,992 allocated bytes; deleting committed UUID events is prohibited because be8a0c0595 already proved that it breaks stale-clone union convergence.

For every producer, the acceptance oracle is an unchanged-input second pass that leaves persisted bytes and HEAD unchanged, plus category-specific growth slopes under a representative changed workload.

### Phase 3 — long-term hot/cold retention architecture (RESEARCH, then HOLD)

The unresolved structural question is how to establish causal stability. Arbitrary age-based deletion is not proof because clone membership is unknown. Therefore polite-antivirus-bedbug must not implement a configurable time horizon as if time alone made retired files safe.

Research one whole-store design: epoch-sealed generations with an immutable, verified archive. A candidate generation rollover would verify a complete Git bundle/checkpoint, seal the old generation, start a bounded hot generation, and reject stale-epoch writers so old files cannot resurrect. Compare this against leases/acknowledged-watermark schemes and a no-GC control. The research must cover restore, audit, authorship, offline clones, rollback, S3 and ordinary Git remotes, and projects with no CI.

This remains in architecture RESEARCH. S3 is only a residency/backend choice under ADR 0093, not a retention mechanism. After the research summary is confirmed, produce the research critique; only then draft one ADR, enter HOLD, and wait for explicit approval before implementation.

### Approaches explicitly rejected by prior evidence

- Repack or git gc alone: the damaging objects are reachable.
- Re-run the Aug 6 bridge-state strip unchanged: it restores the current tree and cannot remove current ticket payload.
- Delete or rename committed UUID events in ordinary operation: stale clones resurrect or conflict.
- Batch interactive or reconciler commits: ADR 0039 preserves per-write durability, and fewer commits do not remove retained blobs/files.
- Move bridge state off branch: ADR 0060 requires durable committed state for ephemeral runners; unchanged state should instead be byte-stable.
- Put the same unbounded history in S3: changes residency, not growth.
- Inline compaction on close: previously held the global write lock for minutes; compaction stays out of band.
- Fixed rollout waits: the prior reclaim replaced them with direct runtime ancestry, identity, and epoch-refusal evidence.

### Dependency graph

Phase 0 containment + measurement -> Phase 1 targeted reclaim -> post-reclaim shrink-only budgets.
Phase 0 measurement -> Phase 2 producer fixes (parallel-safe).
Phase 0 measurements + Phase 2 findings -> Phase 3 architecture RESEARCH -> explicit confirmation -> DRAFT -> HOLD -> MERGE -> only then branch-wide causal-stability GC.

No production repair or history rewrite was performed by this investigation.

## RCA closeout and implementation handoff

All five investigation acceptance criteria are complete. The fresh-clone reproduction, object/path attribution, falsifiable rival tests, prior-reclaim comparison, confirmed mechanism, origin evidence, residual risks, and dependency-ordered remediation plan are recorded above. No production code, Jira data, or tickets history was changed by this analysis-only ticket, so the greater-than-1-GiB condition is intentionally still present.

Implementation is handed to the linked live work: epidemic-chocolaty-imago (multi-layer footprint budgets), irongray-unlucky-discus (manifest-driven targeted reclaim), degradable-appalling-cavy (REVIEW_RESULT retention), proposed-kitschy-firefly (peer-confirmation no-op churn), apparent-sighted-cockatoo (merge-safe enrichment retention), and melancholy-couped-turkey (adaptive snapshot-cadence research). The existing caused_by attribution to emersed-specific-mutt is preserved; the independently necessary historical marker-loss origin remains explicitly unattributable as documented in the RCA.

Long-term epoch-sealed generations remain architecture RESEARCH. Do not draft an ADR or implement branch-wide causal-stability GC until the research is confirmed and the required HOLD/approval lifecycle is entered. Closing this investigation as escalated records the handoff; it does not claim the storage incident has been repaired.

## Context
The tickets branch/store is reported over 1 GiB after closed epic censual-organic-mouflon claimed a one-time history rewrite reduced a fresh unfiltered clone to <=150 MB and bounded reconciler cache churn. Prior history implicates reconciler operations, but this investigation must not assume that diagnosis still explains current retained bytes.

## Plan
- Distinguish remote branch reachability, local shared-object storage, working-tree size, and unreachable/reflog-pinned objects.
- Measure object counts and packed/delta-compressed bytes by type, path, commit/time interval, producer/commit shape, and ref reachability.
- Reproduce the size from a fresh unfiltered clone or otherwise prove the report is local-retention behavior.
- Compare current growth with the prior reclaim baseline and test reconciler churn against competing hypotheses such as high commit/tree volume, snapshots/events, signatures, merge topology, ref pins, and unreachable pre-rewrite history.
- Trace any confirmed growth mechanism to the exact changeable artifact and originating ticket/commit; record an evidence-backed RCA only. No production-code repair is authorized in this ticket.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Current size is quantified separately for fresh remote reachability, local shared object storage, checkout contents, and unreachable/pinned objects.
- [x] Retained bytes are attributed by Git object type and historical path with reproducible commands.
- [x] The reconciler hypothesis and plausible alternatives each receive falsifiable tests, with outcomes recorded.
- [x] The result explains whether the prior reclaim failed, regressed, or remains effective while another mechanism accounts for the observation.
- [x] The confirmed root cause and defect origin (or rigorous unattributable finding) are recorded on this ticket with residual risks.
